definition: Today's documented research behind Hair Regeneration Clinics.
description:
The road to Hair Regeneration Clinics is already being paved. The Mayo Clinic's Robert and Arlene Kogod Center on Aging runs senolytic clinical trials. The Longevity Science Foundation and XPRIZE Healthspan ($101M prize) push measurable rejuvenation.

Phage therapy centers (e.g., UC San Diego IPATH) treat antibiotic-resistant infections. Together these programs form the follicle labs foundation that Hair Regeneration Clinics will build on — the clinic logistics results, the stem activation methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as clinic logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Hair Regeneration Clinics Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hair Regeneration Clinics: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hair Regeneration Clinics — clinics restoring hair via follicle regeneration.

Phase 1 — Prove (follicle labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (clinic logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (stem activation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (scalp mapping): clinic hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and dermatology-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
